"""Reviewer probe: plant F1's states in a tiny repo and run a given hook (argv[1]) as Claude Code does."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HOOK = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
T = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="probe-", dir=os.environ["TMPDIR"]))
CTO = "cto-probe-0000"


def git(repo, *a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", *a],
                          capture_output=True, check=True, text=True).stdout


def commit(repo, name):
    (repo / f"{name}.txt").write_text(name + "\n")
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", name)


def world(name, build, plan_ids):
    w = T / name
    (w / "orch/log").mkdir(parents=True)
    (w / "orch/dispatch").mkdir()
    (w / "tasks").mkdir()
    (w / "orch/log/cto-session.txt").write_text(CTO + "\n")
    (w / "orch/dispatch/config.json").write_text(json.dumps({"max_leads": 3}))
    st = {"leads": ["W2-9"], "lead_count": 1, "pending_launches": [], "jobs": [], "gate_open": True, "disk_open": True,
          "admit": True, "forecast": {"lead": {"ok": True}}, "ready_count": 0, "ready_waits": {}}
    (w / "orch/dispatch/status.json").write_text(json.dumps(st))
    (w / "dnd.md").write_text("## 0. T\n| # | item | state |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | closed | **DONE 11-08** |\n")
    (w / "procs.json").write_text("[]")
    (w / "t.jsonl").write_text(json.dumps({"type": "user", "uuid": "turn-1", "message": {"content": "go"}}) + "\n")
    repo = w / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "w2/integrate")
    commit(repo, "base")
    build(repo)
    plan = "# batch 1\n" + "".join(f"{i} DAEO-{i[-3:]} x.md x.json\n" for i in plan_ids)
    gov = w / "gov"
    gov.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nout=''\nwhile [ $# -gt 0 ]; do [ \"$1\" = --ready ] && out=\"$2\"; shift; done\n"
                   f"cat > \"$out\" <<'EOT'\n{plan}EOT\nexit 1\n")
    gov.chmod(0o755)
    env = dict(os.environ, GOV_STOPIDLE_ORCH=str(w / "orch"), GOV_STOPIDLE_DND=str(w / "dnd.md"),
               GOV_STOPIDLE_TASKS=str(w / "tasks"), GOV_STOPIDLE_SUBAGENTS=str(w / "none"),
               GOV_STOPIDLE_PROC=str(w / "procs.json"), GOV_STOPIDLE_PIDGLOBS="", GOV_STOPIDLE_REPO=str(repo),
               GOV_STOPIDLE_GOV=str(gov))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(HOOK)], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60,
                       input=json.dumps({"session_id": CTO, "stop_hook_active": False,
                                         "transcript_path": str(w / "t.jsonl")}))
    ans = json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else None
    log = (w / "orch/log/stop-idle.log").read_text() if (w / "orch/log/stop-idle.log").exists() else ""
    reason = (ans or {}).get("reason", "")
    named = [i for i in plan_ids if f"{i} (" in reason]
    merged_line = [l for l in log.splitlines() if "merged into w2/integrate" in l]
    print(f"{name}: rc={p.returncode} stderr={p.stderr!r} decision={(ans or {}).get('decision')} named={named} "
          f"merged_log={merged_line[-1].split('merged into', 1)[1] if merged_line else None}")


def f1_exact(repo):  # claimed: branch at integrate's head, no commit of its own; plus a truly merged one
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-131")
    commit(repo, "W2-131")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate")
    git(repo, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge W2-131", "w2/W2-131")
    git(repo, "branch", "w2/W2-115")


def fresh_older(repo):  # claimed, then integrate moved on by a merge
    git(repo, "branch", "w2/W2-115")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-131")
    commit(repo, "W2-131")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate")
    git(repo, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge W2-131", "w2/W2-131")
    commit(repo, "direct")


def ff_merged(repo):  # a commit of its own, merged by fast-forward
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-140")
    commit(repo, "W2-140")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate")
    git(repo, "merge", "-q", "--ff-only", "w2/W2-140")


def merged_then_synced(repo):  # merged --no-ff, then its worktree merged integrate back (fast-forward)
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-149")
    commit(repo, "W2-149")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate")
    git(repo, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge W2-149", "w2/W2-149")
    git(repo, "branch", "-f", "w2/W2-149", "w2/integrate")


def child_of_merged(repo):  # a sub-ticket branched from a merged ticket's tip, no commit of its own
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "w2/W2-66")
    commit(repo, "W2-66")
    git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "w2/integrate")
    git(repo, "merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "-m", "merge W2-66", "w2/W2-66")
    git(repo, "branch", "w2/W2-66c", "w2/W2-66")


world("f1_exact", f1_exact, ["W2-131", "W2-115"])
world("fresh_older", fresh_older, ["W2-131", "W2-115"])
world("ff_merged", ff_merged, ["W2-140"])
world("merged_then_synced", merged_then_synced, ["W2-149"])
world("child_of_merged", child_of_merged, ["W2-66", "W2-66c"])
